name: Danganronpa: Bursting Love
source:
Meet all new friends and join Hajome Hinate and his group of friends as he goes through high school and maybe even falls in love??? You could even call it bursting love. But who will he fall for? The sexy gamer or the creepy cancer kid? It's all up to you in this fun-filled adventure.

[From [url=https://okabee.itch.io/danganronpa-bursting-love]itch.io[/url]]
